_source: Reproduces the single-file (dashed) curves in fig:1D_vs_2D (panels a-c) of the JCP 2026 paper, w_pore = 8 A. Symmetric RPM electrolyte, T=400K, epsr=20, ion diameter 5A, mu_IL/2 = -0.2975 eV.

_units.r_pore_A: Angstrom (nominal pore radius: radius to the centre of the wall atoms)
_units.eshift_A: Angstrom (inward shift of the image-charge screening surface relative to r_pore_A)
_units.ions.mu_eV: eV (bulk electrochemical potential per ion, mu_IL/2)
